description: This file defines classes, enums, and interfaces related to fault injection and transaction state management within Orleans transaction testing framework. It includes classes for controlling fault injection points, transaction fault phases, and transactional state with fault injection capabilities.

classes.name: FaultInjectionControl
classes.description: Class representing control parameters for fault injection, including phase and type, with a method to reset to default values.

classes.name: TransactionFaultInjectPhase
classes.description: Enumeration of different phases during which fault injection can occur in a transaction.

classes.name: FaultInjectionType
classes.description: Enumeration of different types of fault injections that can be performed.

classes.name: IFaultInjectionTransactionalState
classes.description: Interface defining a transactional state with fault injection control, extending ITransactionalState.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionalState
classes.description: Implementation of transactional state with fault injection capabilities, lifecycle participation, and resource factory setup.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the fault injection control parameters to default (None).

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the transactional state to lifecycle setup stage to initialize resources.

methods.name: SetupResourceFactory
methods.description: Sets up resource factories for transactional resources and transaction managers with fault injection support.

methods.name: PerformRead
methods.description: Performs a read operation on the transactional state.

methods.name: PerformUpdate
methods.description: Performs an update operation on the transactional state.
